name: Brex
summary: Corporate cards and AI-automated spend management.
description: Brex provides corporate cards, expense management and bill pay. Its AI assistant checks expense compliance, collects receipts and helps employees follow company policy.
summary_fr: Cartes d'entreprise et gestion des dépenses automatisée par IA.
